title: Export items for backup or transfer (full list only; IDs are account-local)
summary: Writes clover-csv from the live menu and states Clover-specific transfer rules: Clover exports the whole item list only, and the Clover ID column must be blanked before importing into another merchant.

steps.title: Know that the vendor export is all-or-nothing
steps.instructions: Items > Item list > vertical menu > Export gives CloverItemDownload.csv for the full item list; a partial export is not supported, so trim it yourself and keep the original as the backup.

steps.title: Blank the identifier column before importing elsewhere
steps.instructions: Into a different merchant account, delete the Clover ID values or the import targets records that do not exist there. Then rebuild the workbook tabs per object type.
